gaps.title: CFD Pressure Drop Multi-Grid Anomaly Classification
gaps.remediation: Reclassified convergence mode as OSCILLATORY_CONVERGENCE due to pre-asymptotic 8x2x2 mesh resolution (y+ ~ 1700). Monotonic claims strictly rejected when R < 0.

gaps.title: Analytical Poiseuille Navier-Stokes Benchmark Comparison
gaps.evidence: Previous test checked only boundary mass imbalance without analytical pressure gradient or velocity profile ratio.
gaps.remediation: Bound validation to exact Hagen-Poiseuille analytical pressure drop (DeltaP = 12*mu*L*u/H^2 = 3.0e-4 Pa) and centerline velocity ratio (u_max/u_mean = 1.5).

gaps.title: Real Consumption Path Stale Evidence Invalidation
gaps.evidence: Previous test checked string SHA-256 inequality in isolation.
gaps.remediation: Executed full-cycle ledger registration, input mutation (REV-A to REV-B), verification against EvidenceIntegrityChecker returning INVALID/STALE_EVIDENCE_REJECTED, and re-solve binding to REV-B.

gaps.title: Fluid-Structure Interaction (FSI) Scope Boundary Clarification
gaps.evidence: Need clear distinction between 1-way boundary force mapping and full 2-way deformed mesh recomputation.
gaps.remediation: Qualified 1-way boundary normal force transfer (F_n = integral p n dA = 80.0 N); explicitly documented full 2-way deformed mesh recomputation scope boundaries.
